Our portal allows you to view your orders and invoices, as well as manage your licences and subscriptions or those of your establishment. You can also create a support ticket for an after-sales service request.
The link ❶ allows you to choose your password, while the link ❷ is a shortcut to log in to your account.

To delegate the management of your licences and subscriptions, you can send your employees the following link, which will enable them to create an individual account linked to your organisation via a form (child of the account).
Please note that you must not share this link with the public!
